about.title: A contractor trained to design first
about.name: Ayman Nasr
paragraphs: I'm Ayman Nasr, founder and president of Dream Haven Construction. Before I was a general contractor, I trained in architecture and spent about ten years as an interior designer. That background changes how a project goes: I read plans the way a designer does, I sketch options at your kitchen table, and I can tell you what a structural change will involve before we commit to it.

I personally handle your estimate, permits, engineering coordination, scheduling and inspections. You have one point of contact from the first walkthrough to the final sign-off. We don't compete on being the cheapest bid. We compete on doing the work correctly.
